map.估算烟熏室酚类物质浓度与苯并芘暴露风险，辅助工艺优化: Estimate the phenolic concentration in a smoking chamber and benzo[a]pyrene exposure risk to support process optimisation
map.📖 查看「烟熏浓度（苯并芘）模拟使用指南」: 📖 See the "Smoking Concentration (Benzo[a]pyrene) Simulation User Guide"
map.产烟总量(g) = 木屑量 × 发烟率(%) ÷ 100 × 时间，且不超过木屑: Total smoke produced (g) = wood chips × smoke yield (%) ÷ 100 × time, and never more than 70% of the wood chip weight; phenolic concentration in the chamber = total smoke × phenolic share ÷ ventilation volume (volume × air changes × time); benzo[a]pyrene formation rises sharply with temperature, so keep the smoking temperature at 60 to 80 °C (staying below 300 °C markedly reduces it); the risk grade is judged by comparing the concentration with the limit (the benzo[a]pyrene limit for smoked meat products is 5 μg/kg).
map.木屑发烟率 (g 烟/min·100g木屑): Wood chip smoke yield (g smoke/min per 100g wood chips)
map.单位质量木屑每分钟产烟量（经验值）: Smoke produced per minute per unit mass of wood chips (empirical)
map.硬木烟冷凝物中酚类约 5-15%: Phenolics in hardwood smoke condensate are about 5-15%
map.换气越高浓度越低但苯并芘沉积可能增加；传统密闭熏制偏高: More air changes lower the concentration but may increase benzo[a]pyrene deposition; traditional closed smoking runs high
map.温度越高，多环芳烃（含苯并芘）生成越多: The higher the temperature the more polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (including benzo[a]pyrene) form
map.本工具基于经验模型粗略估算，结果仅供工艺参考。苯并芘（BaP）为致癌物，GB 2: This tool gives a rough estimate from an empirical model and is for process reference only. Benzo[a]pyrene (BaP) is a carcinogen, and GB 2762 sets a limit of 5 μg/kg or less for smoked meat products. Ways to lower BaP: use a liquid smoke preparation instead, keep the temperature under 200°C, stop fat dripping onto open flame, shorten the smoking time and add filtration.
map.酚类浓度 ≈ 产酚速率 ÷ 通风流量（产酚=烟量×酚比；烟量受木屑量限）；苯并芘: Phenolic concentration ≈ phenol production rate ÷ ventilation flow (phenol = smoke × phenolic share; smoke is limited by the wood chip amount); benzo[a]pyrene rises with the temperature factor (sharply above 200°C).
map.2 m³ 烟室、木屑 300 g、发烟率 5%、120 min、酚比 8%、通风: For a 2 m³ chamber, 300 g wood chips, 5% yield, 120 min, 8% phenolic share, 3 air changes per hour at 60°C: steady-state phenolics are about 1400 mg/m³ and benzo[a]pyrene about 1.4 μg/m³ (low risk at low temperature); raising it to 300°C increases benzo[a]pyrene by orders of magnitude.
map.控烟温 <200℃（避免明火直烤）、提高通风、缩短熏时、选用清洁发烟，必要时液熏: Keep the smoke temperature under 200°C (avoid direct flame roasting), raise the ventilation, shorten the smoking time, use clean smoke generation, and consider liquid smoke instead.
map.酚类高好还是低好？: Are high phenolics good or bad?
map.酚类贡献烟熏风味但伴生有害物，需在风味与食品安全间平衡，勿过量。: Phenolics give the characteristic smoked flavour but come with harmful compounds, so balance flavour against food safety and do not overdose.
